entries.headline: Six USAF heavy-lift transports reported airborne
entries.summary: War Watch reported six U.S. Air Force heavy-lift transport aircraft airborne over the United States and North Sea, and said eastern Mediterranean air activity was nearly three times its usual level.

entries.headline: Reuters Iran defence-minister report highlighted
entries.summary: War Watch highlighted a Reuters report that Iran’s parliament approved Mehrdad Akhlaqi as defence minister, and said three outlets had confirmed the report.

entries.headline: Egyptian National Defence Council report highlighted
entries.summary: War Watch highlighted an Al Jazeera Arabic report about an Egyptian Presidency statement on a National Defence Council decision, and said two outlets had confirmed the report.

entries.headline: Coded USAF broadcasts and military flights reported
entries.summary: War Watch reported four coded U.S. Air Force radio broadcasts heard that day, along with multiple military transport aircraft and a surveillance drone airborne over the United States.

entries.headline: Ukrainska Pravda warehouse-attack report highlighted
entries.summary: War Watch highlighted a Ukrainska Pravda report that drones attacked an Ozon warehouse in St. Petersburg in the morning, and said two outlets had confirmed the report.

entries.headline: Al Jazeera Arabic tugboat-strike report highlighted
entries.summary: War Watch highlighted an Al Jazeera Arabic report citing UK Maritime Trade Operations as having received notice that a tugboat was struck, and said two outlets had confirmed the report.

entries.headline: USAF command jets and elevated regional activity reported
entries.summary: War Watch reported four U.S. Air Force transport aircraft and two nuclear-command aircraft airborne over the continental United States, and said air activity in the eastern Mediterranean was nearly three times normal.

entries.headline: Six USAF transports reported airborne
entries.summary: War Watch reported six U.S. Air Force transport aircraft airborne over the United States and Europe, describing the level as well above normal for that hour.

entries.headline: SAM576 C-37B sighting reported
entries.summary: War Watch reported a Gulfstream C-37B of the U.S. Air Force 89th Airlift Wing using callsign SAM576 and hex code AE6962. The sighting was credited to reagan0965.

entries.headline: SAM182 C-32A sighting reported
entries.summary: War Watch reported a Boeing C-32A of the U.S. Air Force 89th Airlift Wing using callsign SAM182, hex code ADFEB8 and registration 98-0002. The sighting was credited to reagan0965.

entries.headline: Two USAF command jets and elevated regional activity reported
entries.summary: War Watch reported two U.S. Air Force nuclear-command aircraft and three heavy transport aircraft airborne over the United States, and said air activity near the eastern Mediterranean was nearly four times normal levels.

entries.headline: Boeing E-6B Mercury sighting reported
entries.summary: War Watch reported a Boeing E-6B Mercury sighting with hex code AE0411, registration 163919 and an empty callsign. The sighting was credited to reagan0965.

entries.headline: USAF drone-mimicking adversary contract highlighted
entries.summary: SkyGlass highlighted a Defence Blog report that the U.S. Air Force added a drone-mimicking company to its adversary-training pool.

entries.headline: Navy MQ-25 development award highlighted
entries.summary: SkyGlass highlighted a Defence Blog report that the U.S. Navy awarded Boeing up to $80 million to improve the MQ-25A Stingray drone.
